name: Heavy Leaden Collection Phial
summary: In Kharanos, Ozzie Togglevolt offers the Heavy Leaden Collection Phial for decontamination research. It is meant to draw in unstable irradiated discharge from mutants deep inside Gnomeregan and keep it contained.

sections.title: A Shielded Vessel
sections.body: The Heavy Leaden Collection Phial draws volatile residue from living, irradiated creatures in Gnomeregan. Keeping the fallout inside is difficult. A suitable sample may take several attempts to collect.

sections.title: Pursuit of a Cure
sections.body:
Ozzie Togglevolt provides the phial to help his research into reversing the terrible mutations afflicting leper gnomes. Earlier samples from surface troggs were too weak for useful chemical analysis.

With the leaden phial, researchers hope to gather samples from virulent beasts, including irradiated slimes and lurkers in the Hall of Gears. They seek the active elements in the city's toxic fallout, then hope to make an effective antidote.

faq.q: What is the Heavy Leaden Collection Phial used for?
faq.answer: The phial siphons concentrated radioactive discharge from living, irradiated creatures inside Gnomeregan. Researchers in Kharanos use the samples in decontamination trials.

faq.q: Who provides the Heavy Leaden Collection Phial?
faq.answer: Ozzie Togglevolt, a gnome researcher in Kharanos in Dun Morogh, provides the phial for his research into curing irradiated and afflicted leper gnomes.

faq.q: Why is the phial made of heavy lead?
faq.answer: The phial is described as heavy and leaden, but its precise construction is not explained. Ozzie warns that containing the radioactive fallout is difficult and the sample will collapse quickly.

faq.q: Which creatures must be sampled with the phial?
aliases: what do i use it on
faq.answer: The phial must be used on living, glowing horrors deep inside Gnomeregan. These include irradiated slimes, lurkers, and horrors prowling the lower levels of the Hall of Gears.

angles.text: As a gnome, every bit of volatile fallout secured in the phial brings you closer to reclaiming Gnomeregan and understanding the chemical madness that stole your home.
As an engineer, you can use the phial to collect volatile fallout. Even with a suitable vessel, collecting a sample may take several attempts.
